Explain in three short sentences why an offline backup helps protect family photos.
1. Offline backups allow you to store copies of your photos

1. Offline backups allow you to store copies of your photos on a physical device or cloud service that is not connected to the internet, ensuring data remains secure even if your primary computer loses power.
2. By keeping photos off the internet, you avoid exposing sensitive personal information like passwords and credit card details to unauthorized third parties during transit.
3. This method prevents accidental loss by allowing you to easily recover files from damaged hard drives or lost devices without relying solely on your main storage system.
